note: Circle/Cross swap routine (in the always-zero 0x1c842c..0x2ff000 range): load the raw button word, swap bits 13 (Circle) and 14 (Cross)
pad update 0x3ad0f0 (the only scePadRead caller): lhu a2,2(sp) -> jal 0x2d0200
soft keyboard init 0x37c0c0: open in half-width English (layout +0x10 = 4, charset +0x14 = 4; a1 holds 4) instead of hiragana (0 / 1): sw zero,16(v0); sw a2,20(v0) -> sw a1,16(v0); sw a1,20(v0)

chat input open 0x31d500: also set ATOK to half-width alphanumeric (mode 5, jal 0x308bb0) so it matches the English keyboard row 0x37c144. Without this ATOK stays in hiragana romaji mode until the layout changes (0x31d1f8 only sends the mode on a change), so typed vowels became kana. Same 0x3000 bits as stock (0x1000 when ATOK is up, bit 16), two branches folded to make room; 0x331930 takes no args
